title: A table variable whose column has lineage filters the model when used as a CALCULATE filter
query: VAR NotRed = FILTER ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ), Product[Color] <> "Red" )

source.quote: What really matters is only the data lineage of a column, which is the original column the values have been retrieved from
source.supports: the variable's column still has the lineage of Product[Color]

derivation: NotRed holds Blue and Green, with the lineage of Product[Color]. As a filter argument it filters that column: Blue is rows 4, 6 = 80, Green has no sales. 80.
